name: MyDesign
tagline: Design your own clothes from garment templates, colors and prints — then find a tailor
role: UI/UX design and React Native development

scenes.title: Design clothes, then get them made
scenes.body: Pick a garment, style it with colors and prints, and send the design to a tailor.

scenes.title: A guided design flow
scenes.body: Who it is for, the body shape, then the garment type — one step per screen.

scenes.title: Garments as vector outlines
scenes.body: Each style is an SVG pattern, so sleeves, cuts and prints can be swapped on the fly.

scenes.title: A full spec for the tailor
scenes.body: Measurements, garment details and the order total on one review screen.

scenes.title: Folders for every collection
scenes.body: Group designs into folders, select several and move them in one go.

scenes.title: Orders, tailors and fabrics
scenes.body: Track orders and share designs; the menu leads to tailors, fabrics and tutorials.
